subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) It blows from April to October. (b) We have rain during the monsoon. (c) It blows from the south-west over Bangladesh. (d) The secondary sources of water are streams, lakes and rivers etc. (e) The monsoon is the seasonal wind that blows in from the Bay of Bengal. (f) Water is an important asset. (g) It also blows over the parts of India. (h) Its main source is rain. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences 160 (f) + (h) + (d) + (b) + (e) + (a)+ (c) + (g) Section B : Writing Test
